senses.def: to make an action or process possible or easier
ex: The new road will facilitate trade between the towns.
A good chair facilitates discussion in a meeting.

mistake.wrong: The app facilitates students to learn.
mistake.right: The app facilitates learning. / The app helps students (to) learn.
mistake.note: Do not use facilitate + person + to-infinitive. Its object is the process, not the person.

senses.def: to write all the necessary information on an official document
ex: Fill in your name and address.

senses.def: to get information about something because you want to know more about it
ex: Can you find out when the train leaves?
I found out that she had lied.

mistake.wrong: I want to know-out the price.
mistake.right: I want to find out the price.
mistake.note: Use find out for getting new information.
